name: Alphorn Self-Hosted Notification Router
free_limit: Self-host the AGPL-3.0-or-later notification router for webhook-triggered delivery to 20+ channels, with filtering, retries and delivery history; no vendor-imposed software quota or expiry.
watch_out: Requires your own Docker/Node.js and PostgreSQL infrastructure; SMTP, SMS and other outbound providers may charge separately. AGPL network-use obligations apply to modified deployments; commercial licensing is optional for organizations unable to comply. Hosted Alphorn Free is a separate limited-quota offering.
